Path

## From biological foundations to applied genomics

::: {.home-curriculum-grid role="list" aria-label="MGenética learning phases"}
::: {.home-curriculum-item role="listitem"}
**Foundations**

Animal breeding, phenotype, environment and quantitative genetics basics.
:::

::: {.home-curriculum-item role="listitem"}
**Parameters**

Data exploration, variance, heritability, repeatability and correlations.
:::

::: {.home-curriculum-item role="listitem"}
**Models**

Linear models, BLUP, pedigree, relationship and genetic evaluation.
:::

::: {.home-curriculum-item role="listitem"}
**Genomics**

SNP markers, quality control, GWAS and genomic prediction.
:::
:::

[View all 21 modules](modules/index.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary aria-label="View all modules"}
:::

::: {.home-proof-strip role="list" aria-label="MGenética trust pillars"}
::: {.home-proof-item role="listitem"}
**Scientific rigor**

Content based on quantitative genetics, statistics and field application.
:::

::: {.home-proof-item role="listitem"}
**Clear language**

Direct explanations, controlled jargon and short interpretation.
:::

::: {.home-proof-item role="listitem"}
**Reproducible practice**

Scripts and simulated data for study without external datasets.
:::
:::
